QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] To Pantheon
QuestInfo.0: You've gotten a call from Gen of the Shadowdealers. What do you suppose he wants?
QuestInfo.1: As part of an arrangement with Gen, you've agreed to help the Nova. Go to Pantheon meet Beldar.
QuestInfo.2: You've met Beldar in Pantheon. Hear him out to get the details of the mission.

0.msg: Go straight to Pantheon and meet Beldar.
